step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration number used to send the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select the same work item noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
Work type: Select the same work type noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
Remarks Line 1: Type “This MM06 replaces the MM06 created on [date] for BPC [XXXX].”
Remarks Line 2 to 4: Include all required information.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your name and telephone num ber.
Detection: Select the same detection code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
Infraction: Select the same infraction code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .
Message: Select the same message code as noted on the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if the IPOC WI related to the original Operational Centre Memo (MM06) was created and assigned:

ul.li: If an IPOC WI was created and assigned, go to step 5.
If an IPOC WI was not created or was created but not assigned, no further action is required.

step.cmd: Create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “MM06 — Modification or correction sent on [date].”

Details: Select the appropriate option.
Type “The original MM06 was created with incorrect information. A new MM06 was created. ”
Type “The original MM06 was created, but additional information is required . A new MM06 was created.”
Destination-Level: Select the Service Canada centre (SCC) of the regional IPOC:
End user: Select Specific user and assign the WI to the agent with the IPOC WI.
